steps.name: Madeleine's Concern (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Io] in 「Gerda」, then find [Madeleine] in 「Deborah Snowfield」.

lines.text: (Io gazes at the sky over Gerda with lonely eyes.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It really won't be long now. How long have I... have we been waiting for this day...?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh? What brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Io. I just thought I'd visit. Is this a bad time?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No, it's just that it isn't time yet. Anyway, I'm glad you're here. You're always welcome in Gerda, %s.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You're the reason Medea made up her mind, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me? I haven't done much.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Not much? Too much modesty will get an icicle through your heart. You kept visiting Kali Village and helping its people without a break...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The goddess is grateful as well.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: About Knossos, though. I have some idea, but I'd like to hear it from you... Will you tell me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. Here's what happened...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Io in detail about the events in Knossos.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If it concerns Medea's people, that witch may be involved too.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...I don't know how much I can help... It's something Medea must do herself...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh, I think something is troubling Madeleine. Would you hear her out?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me? Do you think I can help?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I think talking to you would help her more than talking to me, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In that case, I'll go see her.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you. See you later.

steps.name: Madeleine's Concern (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Echo] in 「Echo Spring」 and obtain the <Eternal Snowflake>. Then turn in the quest to [Madeleine] in 「Deborah Snowfield」.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Oh, what brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while, Madeleine.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Did Io say something about me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Did something happen?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: It's nothing serious.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Sigh... I'll tell you. I don't think you'll leave otherwise...

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: He keeps appearing in my dreams. It's been difficult.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Randine. He was your enemy, but I'm trying to remember him in a different way.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: An old tale from Deborah Snowfield speaks of a mysterious flower. They say finding it and keeping it close will bring you pleasant dreams.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: I don't know if it's true, but I've been looking for it. I've searched the whole snowfield without finding anything like it.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: But... I have a feeling it might be in that place I haven't been able to visit...

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: I couldn't bring myself to ask Io. Going there again would surely stir up unpleasant memories...

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Sigh. I can't believe I'm telling you all this, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I'll look for it.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: What? But...

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Then... please. Just one flower.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. Wait here for me.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: All right...

steps.name: Madeleine's Concern (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Echo] in 「Echo Spring」 and obtain the <Eternal Snowflake>. Then turn in the quest to [Io] in 「Gerda」.

lines.text: (Madeleine gazes at the flower %s has brought her.)

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: A tiny flower inside a piece of ice... It looks as though it could stay there forever.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe it's because the ice of Deborah Snowfield is special, but I'm surprised. I didn't see anything like it when I visited the Echo Spring before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Was I able to find it because I was on the other side...?)

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Madeleine?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: I feel better. I don't know if it's the flower, but something gloomy inside me seems to have lifted. Perhaps I'll have pleasant dreams now, too?
(As Madeleine smiles, the ice in her hand suddenly melts.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: The ice has melted...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Perhaps it was made to melt in response to some kind of change...)
(Madeleine quietly gazes at the flower in her hand.)

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: This is a Deborah Snow Flower. It struggles up through the snow to bloom so beautifully, giving hope and comfort to those who see it.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Hope and comfort are what it symbolizes, too... Together with Deborah's special ice, it must become even more special.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: ...Thank you, Adventurer. I'm feeling somewhat better now... But is Io all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What about Io?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: She always says, 'I'm fine. I have to be fine,' and works only for the villagers. I wish she'd take care of herself, too...

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Could you find just one more of those flowers?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll find one and give it to Io. I'd been wanting to give her something myself, so this works out well.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: I'm sorry to trouble you. And thank you.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Now, this flower... Perhaps I could put it in a frame.
